thread:
lina_sales: heads-up — Sapphire Health renewal hitting EOW. current commit $250k, CS pushing for uplift to $350k but they want a big discount. need alignment before I talk to them tomorrow morning.
raj_se: we ran the pilot last month — perf looked fine, but they asked for private/VPC option because of PHI. also want token usage estimates for clinical summaries.
eva_csm: customer wants a price that's close to $0.006/token (they quoted that in the call). current list we gave was ~$0.008. they want a 12mo term and price hold for 18mo ideally.
michael_dealdesk: quick take — standard renewal discount cap is 20% without exec approval. For uplift to $350k we can stretch to 25% with CRO signoff. need to know if PHI/BAA applies because that changes entitlements. here's a quick ratecard snippet they asked to see:
```
annual_commit: $350000
proposed_unit_price: $0.006
discount_proposed: 22%
pilot_clause: 6-week on-prem eval, prorate if fail
```
jordan_legal: tagging in — if they ingest PHI we need a BAA. SOC2 + DPA is baseline, but BAA requires ops/legal review. also, they'll want the usual data-use limitation (service-only) — probably acceptable.
lina_sales: confirmed — they do process patient summaries. customer explicitly asked for an on-prem 6-week eval before committing. they'll want SE support during pilot.
raj_se: on-prem POC is doable but ops will need ~2 weeks to provision. I can draft a runbook and include smoke tests. we should also include a fallback: hosted with VPC until on-prem ready.
michael_dealdesk: recommendation: offer 22% discount on the $350k commit, 12-month term, add pilot clause that invoices are prorated if pilot fails. include 40h SE credit for the pilot. this stays within deal desk tolerance, CRO sign-off required for any >22%.
eva_csm: they asked for an 18-month price hold — can we give a price hold for 12 months + annual true-up? they'd accept that but will push back.
jordan_legal: I'll draft the BAA + pilot SOW. confirm whether IP/data clauses need tightening — they asked that outputs not be used for model training. we should accept service-only data use.
lina_sales: ok i'll confirm with customer: (1) PHI -> BAA required, (2) pilot dates, (3) agree to 22% discount on $350k with 12mo term + pilot SOW + 40h SE.
catalina_cro: looping me in for visibility — I can approve up to 25% if we get commit and the pilot signoff. please route for quick review.
michael_dealdesk: action items: @michael_dealdesk to route to CRO for sign-off, @jordan_legal to draft BAA/SOW, @raj_se to produce runbook and provisioning ETA, @lina_sales to reconfirm customer ok with 22% and pilot dates. will update SFDC after CRO decision.
sfdc-bot: Opportunity updated — Sapphire Health renewal: stage set to Negotiation, commit updated to $350000, owner lina_sales.
